about_the_game:
You’ve been here before. You’ll be here again. Survive the nightmare that doesn't end. ​

An endless nightmare; You awaken in Ekera, the nightmarish hellscape realm of rot & torment. Where the souls of the dead fight & die without rest. The only way to escape is to wake up, but even death does not free you from Ekera's grasp.

With only your weapon, your stamina, and your will to fight, fight your way through endless hordes of damned souls as long as you can; for when you fall, and you will fall - Ekera remembers.

Sandrotten: Ekera is a never ending horde hack & slash where you fight your way through endless hordes of tormented undead beings, with the difficulty increasing after each kill. How many can you take down before your inevitable fall?

content_descriptors.notes: Constant use of lethal and non lethal weaponry against enemies by the player, and against the player by enemies.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 3100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-12400 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GEFORCE RTX 4070 / AMD RX 7800
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: An endless horde hack & slash with souls-like combat mechanics. Fight your way through endless waves of undead, and see just how far you can make it before the Sandrotten horde takes you down.
